text:
Marcus: Heads-up — Starlane Systems wants to run a joint perf/W benchmark on their new S3 SoC. They want our scripts + kernel tuning recommendations. Can we scope?
Sophia: Nice. primary metric = throughput per watt? steady-state and tail latency too?
Marcus: Exactly: perf/W (tokens/sec / watt), 95th tail latency, and a short kernel counter set. Target workload: Llama-13B quantized, seq=1024. We'll try q4 and q8 runs.
Anya: Do they expose on-board telemetry or do we need to ship our agent?
Marcus: They have IPMI + DCIM exports. Preferred flow: run our harness and ingest their IPMI CSV. Final verification with external power meter.
Lia: Timeline?
Marcus: Proposal: dry-run Tue 10:00 PT, full sweep Wed-Thu. Dry-run verifies harness + telemetry alignment.
Raj: Kernel tuning checklist I'm proposing: set cpufreq governor=performance; enable hugepages; pin IRQ affinity away from GPU threads; disable deep C-states for steady measurements; ensure IOMMU config matches their setup. We'll try an MPS config if NV GPUs present.
Sophia: Can we give them a minimal script so they can validate infra before the dry-run?
bench-bot: sample harness uploaded to: https://internal.redwood/bench/starlane/run_starlane.sh (private link)
Marcus: Snippet below that we'll send to Starlane as the quick smoke: 
```
#!/bin/bash
./run_bench.sh \\--model llama-13b \\--seq 1024 \\--quant q4 \\--batch 8 \\--duration 600 \\--telemetry ipmi,csv \
```
Anya: Legal check — we need an NDA amendment for low-level telemetry and aggregated logs before they share per-core power traces. @LegalTeam will need to sign off.
Lia: Also need to align marketplace/announcement timing. Marketing needs 10 business days after we have verified numbers + partner logo clearance.
Marcus: Partner contact is Evan (evan@starlane.com). I'll intro Evan to Anya + Raj after we lock schedule.
Raj: Measurement details: 1) warmup 1k requests; 2) run steady-state 10 iterations of 10 minutes each; 3) sample power via IPMI every 5s; 4) compute throughput/power over steady windows. Save raw CSVs and a condensed JSON summary.
Sophia: Good. Add fallback model in case the 13B runs OOM or is unstable — we should include a 7B config so they can reproduce latencies across model sizes.
Anya: I'll prepare a runbook and a checklist of kernel knobs + required logs. Will also add the NDA note and data retention period.
Marcus: Can people confirm dry-run slot Tue 10:00 PT?
Sophia: +1
Lia: +1
Raj: +1
bench-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 2026-03-31T17:00:00Z (auto-scheduled).
Marcus: I'll send calendar invite and pre-reqs. Raj, can you push the kernel patchset and a short README into the bench repo by EOD Monday?
Raj: Yep — will open PR and tag @Anya for review. PR will include test kernel configs and instructions to revert.
Anya: Adding Legal + Marketing to the external email thread when I intro Evan. Also will request telemetry samples up front so we can sanity-check formatting.
Marcus: Any other blockers?
Sophia: Just one ask — let's document the exact power aggregation method (mean vs trimmed mean) in the runbook so marketplace numbers are deterministic.
Raj: We'll use 5% trimmed mean over the steady-state windows and record raw samples for audit.
Marcus: Great. I'll draft the partner email now and post it here before sending. Thanks team.
